Victor Wembanyama scored the Spurs' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 32 times in 77 starts, or 42% of the games they started. Devin Vassell was next with 21. The Spurs made the game's first field goal in 59% of their 104 games and won 79% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
